sources.snippet: MOSS-Image is the latest image generation model developed by the OpenMOSS team. The OpenMOSS team is a research team established by three parties: Fudan University, Shanghai Innovation Institute (SII), and MOSI Intelligence. They have released many AI models in addition to MOSS-Image.

sources.title: darask0/Krea-2-color-depth-control · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Control latents are the Krea 2 VAE (AutoencoderKLQwenImage) encoding of the control image, with depth replicated to RGB and pixels scaled to [-1, 1]. Use the posterior mean at inference, normalize with the VAE's latents_mean / latents_std, and pack 2×2 like the image latent. A zero latent means "no control" for that input. The output projection is unchanged: the model still predicts the usual target for the noisy latent only.

sources.snippet: If you follow open image models, this lands in a busy month. We have covered FLUX.3 Image Klein, the 8-step Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, Halcyon, trained without language pretraining and Sperid Iris, a pixel-space model with no VAE. MOSS-Image's pitch is different: precise control over where things go.
